title: Azure AI Model Inference API , requires custom url params to be set for the openai compatibility API
body:
### Feature Description

Azure AI Model Inference API , requires custom url params to be set for the openai compatibility API

### Use Cases

As mentioned [here](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/machine-learning/reference-model-inference-chat-completions?view=azureml-api-2) Azure AI Model Inference API which is a openai compatible service , requires custom url param `api-version` to be set. 

### Additional context

_No response_

linked_prs.title: feat (provider/openai-compatible): add support for optional custom URL parameters in requests.
linked_prs.body:
Updated version of #4340. Closes #4339.

Azure AI Model Inference API requires custom url params to be set for the OpenAI compatibility API. This PR adds a provider setting `queryParams` to support this.
